feedback: Claires confession follows the main pre-vote chain: original contents were retained, intake received the warning, she had collection access and handled the waiting glass, then falsely claimed authorization for an empty bottle. The precise action of taking poison during the preview is newly confessed but does not introduce a new evidentiary mechanism; the open physical bottle and subsequent cupboard access were already established. Her apology to Reed earns emotional force because their professional conflict had developed over several rounds. Chip and Brie resolve their competing appearances cleanly. I found the ending satisfying, although the confession supplies certainty that the circumstantial evidence did not entirely provide against separate contamination by Brie.
